issues.title: Map placeholder in background of support panel
issues.body:
Eventually the `PlanningChannel` will have a `LeafletJS` map in the background.

But, that's not until the next phase.

So, for now we should just put a static image on the background, so we can start learning about it:
![map image](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0e/Europe_countries_map_en_2.png)

Aaah, could we have a copy of that image on our repo?  It will be useful to demonstrate what things look like on a network without an internet connection.

The SupportPanel should _float over_ the map image.
